# Icon Library Studio

> Open-source, 100% browser-based monorepo to inspect webfonts, compile SVGs into production icon fonts (`.woff` / `.ttf` / `.css` / `catalog.json`), browse demo icon sets, and generate or catalog original icons with AI coding agents.

Live site: https://icons.cesaroeduardo.com  
Studio: https://icons.cesaroeduardo.com/studio/  
Self-host guide: https://icons.cesaroeduardo.com/#docs-selfhost  
GitHub: https://github.com/cesaroeduardo/icon-library-visualization  
Author: https://cesaroeduardo.com/  
Resources: https://resources.cesaroeduardo.com/  
License: MIT

This file is the map for LLMs and coding agents. Prefer reading the linked paths before inventing structure.

## What this project is

- **Landing + docs** (`apps/web`): React 19 marketing site and documentation at `/` and `#docs*`.
- **Studio** (`apps/studio`): Vue 3 app at `/studio/` — gallery of demo libraries, webfont inspector, SVG → webfont compiler, upload flow.
- **Self-host** (`apps/selfhost`): separate static gallery of **only** the user’s icons from `icons/` (no demos, no landing).
- **Core** (`packages/core`): shared browser engine (SVG validate/prepare, SVG → TTF/WOFF, webfont + catalog parsers).
- **AI skills** (`skills/`): installable `SKILL.md` packages for agents (create-icons, catalog-icons).

Everything runs in the browser for Studio uploads; self-host builds fonts at build time from the `icons/` folder.

## Install AI skills

```bash
npx skills add cesaroeduardo/icon-library-visualization
```

Individual skills:

```bash
npx skills add cesaroeduardo/icon-library-visualization --skill create-icons
npx skills add cesaroeduardo/icon-library-visualization --skill catalog-icons
```

Zips also ship on the site: `/skills/create-icons.zip`, `/skills/catalog-icons.zip`.

## Monorepo map

```text
apps/
  web/                 # Landing page + docs (React 19 + Tailwind v4) → dist/
  studio/              # Icon Library Studio (Vue 3) → dist/studio/
  selfhost/            # Own-library-only gallery + webfont build
packages/
  core/                # Shared SVG/webfont/catalog engine (@icon-library/core)
  skill/               # Skill packaging helpers
skills/
  create-icons/        # Generate original 24×24 SVG icon libraries
  catalog-icons/       # Build/validate searchable catalog.json
scripts/
  build-all.mjs        # Unified production build (web + studio)
  fetch-demo-libraries.mjs
  dev.mjs
branding/              # Shared brand / favicon assets
```

## Apps — where to change what

### `apps/web` — landing & docs

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `apps/web/src/App.tsx` | Landing layout, hero, footer, docs routing |
| `apps/web/src/content.ts` | PT/EN copy, URLs, agent prompt |
| `apps/web/src/docsContent.ts` | Documentation sections |
| `apps/web/src/components/IconExplorer.tsx` | Demo icon explorer on the LP |
| `apps/web/src/components/SkillsSection.tsx` | Skills + agent canvas section |
| `apps/web/src/components/AgentCanvasShowcase.tsx` | Animated agent-drawing showcase |
| `apps/web/src/components/DocsView.tsx` | Docs UI |
| `apps/web/public/` | Static assets (favicons, og.png, skill zips, this llms.txt) |

Dev: `pnpm run dev:web` → http://localhost:5173

### `apps/studio` — public Studio

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `apps/studio/src/App.vue` | Shell, header, view switching (gallery / create-own / upload) |
| `apps/studio/src/components/IconGallery.vue` | Searchable gallery, export zip |
| `apps/studio/src/components/CreateOwnHub.vue` | Entry hub: SVG compile, webfont upload, self-host CTA, skills |
| `apps/studio/src/components/SvgUpload.vue` | SVG → webfont compiler UI |
| `apps/studio/src/components/WebfontUpload.vue` | Webfont inspector UI |
| `apps/studio/src/i18n.js` | PT/EN strings |
| `apps/studio/src/main.css` | TUFFUI button/surface tokens |

Dev: `pnpm run dev:studio` → http://localhost:5174  
Prod URL path: `/studio/`

### `apps/selfhost` — own library only

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `apps/selfhost/icons/` | **Source of truth** — put SVGs here (subfolders OK) |
| `apps/selfhost/icons/catalog.json` | Optional searchable metadata |
| `apps/selfhost/selfhost.config.json` | title, fontName, prefix, logo, base, allowUpload |
| `apps/selfhost/brand/logo.svg` | Product logo in the gallery header |
| `apps/selfhost/src/App.vue` | Self-host gallery UI |
| `apps/selfhost/README.md` | Human + agent guide |

```bash
pnpm --filter @icon-library/selfhost build   # → apps/selfhost/dist/
pnpm --filter @icon-library/selfhost dev     # → http://127.0.0.1:5175
```

Publish **only** `apps/selfhost/dist/` when the user wants a company gallery without demos.

## Packages

### `packages/core` (`@icon-library/core`)

Shared browser logic used by Studio and self-host builds:

- SVG prepare / validate
- SVG → TTF / WOFF compilation
- Webfont + CSS parsing
- `catalog.json` parsing helpers

Entry: `packages/core/src/index.js`

### `packages/skill`

Packaging utilities for shipping skill zips (`pnpm run pack:skill`).

## AI skills — paths agents should open first

### `skills/create-icons`

Generates an **original** icon library matched to a project’s design system (never copy Lucide/Phosphor/etc. paths).

| Start here | Why |
|------------|-----|
| `skills/create-icons/SKILL.md` | Full workflow |
| `skills/create-icons/references/drawing-guide.md` | Grid, stroke, path craft |
| `skills/create-icons/references/styles/` | 8 starter styles |
| `skills/create-icons/scripts/validate.py` | Must pass before shipping |
| `skills/create-icons/scripts/build.py` | Package / catalog / gallery |

Typical outputs: SVGs, framework components, `catalog.json`, review catalog.

### `skills/catalog-icons`

Builds or merges a searchable `catalog.json` from an SVG folder or webfont CSS.

| Start here | Why |
|------------|-----|
| `skills/catalog-icons/SKILL.md` | Workflow |
| `skills/catalog-icons/references/catalog-schema.md` | Schema + keyword rules |
| `skills/catalog-icons/scripts/catalog_icons.py` | Scan / merge / validate |

Schema shape:

```json
[
  {
    "name": "home",
    "icon": "ic home",
    "label": "Home",
    "group": "navigation",
    "keywords": "house start dashboard inicio casa"
  }
]
```

## Recommended agent workflows

### A. Generate icons and self-host them

1. Install skills (`npx skills add cesaroeduardo/icon-library-visualization`).
2. Run **create-icons** against the user’s design system → original SVGs + optional catalog.
3. Run **catalog-icons** if catalog enrichment is needed.
4. Copy SVGs (+ `catalog.json`) into `apps/selfhost/icons/`.
5. Edit `apps/selfhost/selfhost.config.json` and `apps/selfhost/brand/logo.svg`.
6. `pnpm --filter @icon-library/selfhost build` and publish `apps/selfhost/dist/`.

### B. One-off experiment in the browser

1. Open https://icons.cesaroeduardo.com/studio/#create-own
2. Upload SVGs or a webfont — compilation stays local in the browser.
3. Export a `.zip` bundle from the gallery when ready.

### C. Change the marketing site / Studio UI

- Copy: `apps/web/src/content.ts`, `apps/studio/src/i18n.js`
- LP sections: `apps/web/src/App.tsx`, `components/*`
- Studio chrome: `apps/studio/src/App.vue`
- Unified deploy: `pnpm run build` → `dist/` (web) + `dist/studio/`

## Commands cheat sheet

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm run dev:web          # LP + docs :5173
pnpm run dev:studio       # Studio :5174
pnpm run dev:selfhost     # Self-host gallery :5175
pnpm run build            # Unified static site → dist/
pnpm run build:selfhost   # Self-host only → apps/selfhost/dist/
pnpm run pack:skill       # Repack skill zips
```

## Demo libraries (Studio / LP explorer)

Phosphor (multiple weights), Feather, Pixelarticons, Hugeicons — MIT demos only. They are **not** part of a self-host deploy.
